dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus database of physical samples from wells del gt 01 and del gt 02

description: TU Delft publishes the relational inventory of physical samples collected during installation of campus geothermal wells DEL-GT-01 and DEL-GT-02 between June and November 2023. The resource records samples registered at the drilling site and supplies individual sample inventories. The provider identifies an Access database and CSV and Excel spreadsheets. A separate web application based on the database structure is referenced and is not treated as this dataset. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft campus geothermal site in the Netherlands. Sample registration is campaign-based; sampling intervals are not reported. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: This is a sample inventory, not physical specimens or their laboratory measurements. Sample requests follow a separate provider procedure. Simulation uses include geothermal subsurface input provenance and sample selection. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
